description: Disk-level batch encoding converter with detection — convert files or folders between any encodings without opening them.
command.convert.title: Convert Encoding
command.convertWithOptions.title: Convert Encoding with Options…
config.sourceEncoding: Source encoding used by the one-click command: 'auto' detects the encoding per file (BOM → strict UTF-8 validation → ranked detection verified by lossless decode), or an explicit encoding id such as gbk. Explicit ids bypass binary sniffing but are strictly validated.
config.targetEncoding: Target encoding for the one-click command. Any iconv-lite id is accepted; the canonical ids utf-8, utf-8-bom, utf-16le, utf-16be fully determine BOM handling.
config.onUnmappable: What to do when the target encoding cannot represent a character: fail rejects the file without writing; replace substitutes '?' and warns.
config.batchExcludes: Glob patterns (relative to the scanned folder) excluded from recursive folder conversion.
config.maxFileSizeMB: Files larger than this are skipped. 0 disables the limit.
config.detectionConfidenceThreshold: Minimum detection confidence (0–100) required before a detected source encoding is accepted in auto mode.
